text_block_list.text:
The annual Summer Training Camp begins. 
Fuji Kiseki brought everyone together like 
the true dorm head she is, adored by her 
juniors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki, the dependable dorm head. 
After this summer training camp, she is 
sure to set an even greater example for 
her juniors!
